summary: Expose the controller AbortSignal used to notify sink algorithms of stream abort.

target.notes: The AbortSignal surface is owned by WEB_ABORT_SIGNALS; this rule owns only stream integration.

semantics.normal: returns a stable AbortSignal tied to the controller
semantics.edge: aborting the stream aborts this signal with the stream abort reason
